subject.title: BL-ecommerce-product-06: product page missing x1.37 reference price fallback when new price is unknown

question: Should this divergence be fixed now by creating/updating the BL-ecommerce-product-06 spec and test in the fix PR, or should it wait for the Product Page BL mother issue to land those artefacts first?
rationale: The runtime bug is clear, but the repository BL workflow expects linked spec/function/test artefacts and the specific ecommerce Product Page spec is absent from dev.

options.title: Fix now with BL artefacts
options.body: Create or update the BL-ecommerce-product-06 spec/test in the same narrow fix PR so the behavior and rule documentation land together.

options.title: Wait for mother BL branch
options.body: Keep this issue open until the Product Page BL block provides the spec/test files, then apply the behavior fix against that structure.

recommendation.title: Fix now with BL artefacts
recommendation.body: Create or update the BL-ecommerce-product-06 spec/test in the same narrow fix PR so the behavior and rule documentation land together.
